newsitem.title: GERMANY: Kinkel condemns Jerusalem attack as "cowardly".
newsitem.headline: Kinkel condemns Jerusalem attack as "cowardly".

text.p: German Foreign Minister Klaus Kinkel on Wednesday condemned an attack in a crowded outdoor market in Jewish West Jerusalem killing 18 people as a "cowardly deed".

"I am deeply shocked by the news of the terrible attack in Jerusalem," Kinkel, who is currently on an official visit to Ukraine, said in a letter of condolence to his Israeli counterpart David Levy issued in Bonn. "The cowardly deed can only be condemned in the strongest terms."

Police in Jerusalem said the attack was apparently the work of Moslem militant suicide bombers. The bombings were by far the deadliest attack in Israel since Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's election 14 months ago.
On behalf of the German government, Kinkel paid his condolences to the relatives of the victims and the Israeli government in the letter distributed by his ministry.

"My deepest sympathy goes to the relatives of the victims who have been affected in this terrible way. I convey to you and the Israeli government my heartfelt sympathy," Kinkel told Israeli Foreign Minister Levy.
"We should not allow the originators and perpetrators to succeed in their aim of destroying the peace process in the Middle East with such an attack," Kinkel said.
